_comment: This file contains the parameters for the graph used to set the desired temperature profile within the climate chamber.

max_points.name: max_points
max_points._comment: Amount of points set by the user onto the graph.

min_x.name: min_x
min_x._comment: First setpoint x-value cannot be smaller than 0.

min_y.name: min_y
min_y._comment: Minimum achievable temperature in climate chamber.

max_y.name: max_y
max_y._comment: Minimum achievable temperature in climate chamber.

max_rico.name: max_rico
max_rico._comment: Handles how fast temperature can drop. (Tends to be non linear)

max_rico_heating.name: max_rico_heating
max_rico_heating._comment: Handles how fast temperature can increase. (Tends to be non linear)

max_rico_cooling.name: max_rico_cooling
max_rico_cooling._comment: Handles how fast temperature can decrease. (Tends to be non linear)

heating_curve_factor.name: heating_curve_factor
heating_curve_factor._comment: Factor representing non-linear heating behavior (0-1, where lower=more curved/slower approach, 1=linear). Heating starts fast then slows approaching target.

cooling_curve_factor.name: cooling_curve_factor
cooling_curve_factor._comment: Factor representing non-linear cooling behavior (0-1, where lower=more curved/slower approach, 1=linear). Cooling starts fast then slows approaching target.
